semantics.rapier-eval.mjs: Suffix of calibration; road-only vehicle sanity, two-world bitwise pose determinism, seeded contact-rich fixtures, three 600-step performance scenarios; console reports, explicit world.free. Prefix is batch05.
semantics.side-world.html: Static result-output host for module deep-sideworld.js; promises window.__sideworld.result by explanatory text.
semantics.spike-data.js: GLX capture stub installed before engine evaluation; night Tracks.build, lighting defaults including warmup override, raw meshes and car, 22 grid transforms, per-frame nearest-light cull.
semantics.three-spike.html: Standalone manually copied engine script sequence, one circuit, import map and ES-module scene. Missing script targets are retained as metadata, not corrected.
semantics.three-spike.js: WebGPURenderer initialization and backend selection, partial procedural TSL port, 32 stride15 lamps, shadow/bloom, 22-mesh vs instancing, orbit controls and __spike automation surface.

limits: Read coverage is exactly group06, not complete rapier-eval prefix.
Static findings do not certify harness boot, physical accuracy, cross-host determinism, GPU speed or visual parity.
Scoped consumer search is not universal absence proof.
Historical version claims in comments disagree with import-map dependency metadata.
